name: @sharedid-edge/module-clickid
description: SharedID Edge module: keeps ad click IDs (gclid, gbraid, wbraid, dclid, fbclid, msclkid, ttclid) from the landing page's URL in server-set first-party cookies

sharedidEdge.name: clickid
sharedidEdge.title: keep ad click IDs from the landing page
sharedidEdge.summary: Nothing in the payload: stores the ad click IDs in the landing page's URL (`gclid`, `gbraid`, `wbraid`, `dclid`, `fbclid`, `msclkid`, `ttclid`, and any you add) in server-set first-party cookies for 90 days from the click, for conversion and analytics tags on later page views; never sent to bidders
